title: Skills
description: Flat list of technical skills grouped by category, mirroring the CV's skill groups. Referenced by id from experience.json, projects.json and certifications.json. Meant to be consumed by AI tools such as `get_skills` / `get_skills_by_category`.

category.description: High-level grouping used to render skill sections.

featured.description: Highlight this skill (e.g. top skills widget).

order.description: Manual sort order, ascending, within this file.

visible.description: Toggle to hide the skill without deleting it.
